runs.name: TPI Composites, Inc.
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$0.01** (OTC Pink, aggregator digrin.com monthly close shown October 2026, fetched 2026-10-13, aggregator, flagged; Yahoo, Stooq and the OTC Markets API returned nothing; the level below a cent is unknown). Shares **48,765,812**, one class (FY2025 10-K cover at 2026-01-31, acc 0001193125-26-124194, taken by hand because `Screens/cover_shares.py` cannot resolve a deregistered ticker; issued less treasury 48,766 thousand at 2025-12-31); cap **$0.49M**. Sovereign **5.60%** (USD; Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-09). Company state from the filings: chapter 11 since 2025-08-11 (S.D. Texas), Nasdaq suspended 2025-08-19 and Form 25 2025-09-12, the FY2025 10-K expecting the common to receive no distribution and be canceled; section 363 sales signed March 2026 (Vestas: Chennai about $10.0M, Matamoros about $14.0M; ECP Blade Holdings: the U.S. and Mexico business about $20.0M; GE Vernova back-up about $21.0M; 8-Ks 0001193125-26-094276 and 0001193125-26-097651); Form 15 2026-03-26 (acc 0001193125-26-126250) ends reporting. Filings read: the FY2025 10-K, the FY2024 10-K (0000950170-25-024274), the FY2020 10-K (0001564590-21-008945), the two March 2026 8-Ks; the Q3 2025 10-Q and the 2024 proxy not read. One figure cross-checked: total liabilities $1,021.9M at 2025-12-31 on the filed balance sheet, equal to the XBRL value. `tools/run.py` run through a wrapper in the research folder that patches only the CIK lookup (said so in the run). Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7. Competitors: of the rivals the 10-K names, only GE Vernova (parent of LM Wind Power) files with the SEC; Sinoma, Aeolon, Aeris, ZhongFu, Indutch and Vestas's own plants flagged as not read. **Q1 IN**: a contract maker of wind blades for a few turbine makers under dedicated-capacity agreements, economics readable from the figures (GE Vernova 56.4% and Vestas 41.9% of 2025 sales). **Q2 OUT**: the attacker with money is the customer, buying the plants for about $44M against 2025 sales of $918.5M; contracts carry annual price reductions with raw materials passed through; "all of our current customers" make blades in-house; customers five in 2020, two in 2025, one planned; 7,800 of 9,600 staff in Mexico, imports of many Mexico-made blades held by U.S. Customs; operating income -$402.4M summed over 2016 to 2025, best margin 7.6%; GE's renewable and GE Vernova's wind margins also negative from 2019 (defined differently, said so). Q3 to Q12 not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash -$91.6M a year (FY2021 to FY2025 mean, capex basis; -$114.4M with paid-in-kind interest and finance-lease principal), positive in two of ten years, ten-year sum -$541.3M; range **-$25.07 a share** all-equity on the ten-year record as cycle base (a CONVENTION of this run: no completed cycle to average), -$38.73 on the literal window, against $0.01; no case earns the floor; fair **-$18.03** all-equity, -$11.09 equity-only, no positive figure; no alert. Ten balance sheets read: equity $107M (2016) to $221M (2018) to -$679M (2025), retained earnings -$1,118M; cash $13.9M; DIP $23.9M, current debt $432.2M, liabilities subject to compromise $323.8M ahead of the common; goodwill about $3M throughout. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: retention bonuses approved 2025-06-13 and paid two months before the petition ($1,225,459 to the chief executive, $518,155 to the chief financial officer); performance shares tied to Adjusted EBITDA, featured throughout the MD&A. Contamination declared by the analyst: names of other 2026-10-13 run files in a directory listing, the SITE commit subjects, memory lines on queue state; none names TPI; nothing used. Commits c6e1776a, a245ac65, 279470d9, 8f299aa0. Citations: the analyst's check PASS (29 ids); the dispatcher's script (`dispatcher_quote_check.py`) found 25 fragments, none unmatched, every id in the ledger, no E-id. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) no route for a security its own issuer says will be canceled; the file had to travel to Q2 to close on the business when the filer had closed it on the share; (2) Q7 specific (a) presumes a last full cycle, which a business with its only positive years at the start of its record lacks (a CONVENTION of this run, the sign unchanged without it); (3) `tools/run.py` and `Screens/cover_shares.py` resolve names only through SEC's live ticker file, so a deregistered filer needs a hand-made wrapper (a `--cik` argument would remove the departure); (4) the reporting figures assume a positive range; here both are negative. Could not get: a price below the cent; the non-SEC rivals' accounts.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: a contract maker of composite wind blades in chapter 11 since 2025-08-11, its common expected by its own 10-K to be canceled; the customers make blades in-house, cut its prices by contract each year, and are buying its plants for about $44M against 2025 sales of $918.5M (Vestas, ECP Blade Holdings, GE Vernova back-up); operating income -$402.4M over ten years; Q1 IN. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: owner cash -$91.6M a year, range -$25.07 a share all-equity against $0.01, fair -$18.03 all-equity (-$11.09 equity-only), no positive figure, not armed. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: retention bonuses paid two months before the petition; Adjusted EBITDA featured and tied to pay.
